text:
olivia: heads up — FRA customs is holding AWB 5Z123456789. getting pinged by infra about capacity impact. can vendor confirm reroute / split options? we need ETA impact and any insurance offset you can offer.
zenith-ops: saw it. can do two options: (A) split 10 units air express (2-3 business days) + rest sea (ETA +7 days), air surcharge +$1.8k/unit; or (B) hold and push full reroute sea (ETA +9 days) with 60% insurance credit on depot fees. need PO approval.
maria: @olivia we can accept partial arrivals but depot slot is tight next week. temporary leaseback of 14 days is possible (we'll stage on-site) — cost estimate below.
maria: ```
leaseback (14d): $250/day for staging + handling $120/unit one-time
if air split: add expedited handling $90/unit
```
shipment-bot: Carrier update: AWB 5Z123456789 — "Documentation review" status. ETA window updated +36h.
chris: if parts arrive without serial manifest, ops will need temp IDs and a short RMA flow change. that's ~2 people-days of reconciliation.
olivia: vendor — how firm is the insurance credit? we can trade off some expedite if you absorb depot standby fees.
zenith-ops: insurance credit is conditional — need photos & depot invoice within 48h of delivery. we can absorb standby fees up to $5k if you commit to split routing now.
kevin: on procurement side, if we go air-split we accept the +$1.8k/unit for up to 12 units. beyond that we need tiered pricing. can you run a quote for 12/24/36?
zenith-ops: running quote now, will post in thread.
jess: note for infra: if we stage here, label policy requires serial reconciliation within 72h or units go into quarantine. forewarn ops.
zenith-ops: quote: 12 air units = +$21k total (incl handling). 24 split = +$38k. 36 split = +$54k. (numbers include carrier markup + expedited handling). details in export.
olivia: thanks. tagging finance to sign off on +21k if we keep rest sea. @maria can you confirm staging buffer and confirm the 72h serial SLA?
maria: we can do buffer for up to 18 units next Tue–Thu. 72h SLA realistic but will need temporary overtime (will bill).
chris: also confirm RMA path: if DOA discovered at depot, vendor will issue RMA pick within 5 business days? need explicit SLA to avoid double-billing.
zenith-ops: yes — RMA pickup SLA 5bd. we'll also accept photos via email for first triage to speed credit.
olivia: ok — propose final: split 12 air now, rest sea; vendor covers standby up to $5k; we pay +21k; staging accepts 18 units buffer; RMA SLA 5bd. any objections?
kevin: thumbs up from procurement.
jess: won't block. just send manifest with temp IDs if serials incomplete.
chris: will prepare a short runbook for ops reconciliation and temp-ID process.
zenith-ops: proceeding with booking. will follow up with AWB numbers for the air shipment and updated ETA for sea. expect new docs in ~2h. :white_check_mark:
olivia: great — please cc invoices & depot photo checklist when you send AWBs. thanks everyone. :pray:
